entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Pace cycling shoes. And I see you're a VIP member with us, we really appreciate your business.
So I can process this correctly for you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They gave me blisters. They're horrible.

Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I know how frustrating that can be. Did you get a chance to reposition the cleats or try different socks? Sometimes a small adjustment can make a world of difference in preventing blisters.
I tried. They're just not right. I want a refund.

Of course. No problem at all. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for you... Okay, I see they were delivered 22 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy for our cycling shoes. I can absolutely approve that return for you.

And since you're a VIP member, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive it, the full refund will go back to your card.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
You certainly will. That email with the label should be in your inbox now. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. We hope you have a great rest of your day.
